content: Root cause: The bug was caused by writing to `vmcb->rax` instead of `guest_regs->rax`. The commit identified that `vmcb->rax` was being overwritten with the value from `guest_regs->rax` during guest resume, leading to loss of data when modifications were made to `vmcb->rax`. This made it clear that `vmcb->rax` should not be altered directly, and all modifications need to be made to `guest_regs->rax` to avoid losing important register values.
